[SWS_EthSwt_91052] Definition of API function EthSwt_ReadMmd ⌈
Service Name
EthSwt_ReadMmd
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthSwt_ReadMmd (
uint8 SwitchIdx,
uint8 SwitchPortIdx,
uint8 Mmd,
uint16 RegIdx,
uint16* RegValPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0xa6
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different SwitchIdx, non reentrant for same SwitchIdx
SwitchIdx
Index of the switch.
SwitchPortIdx
Index of the port at the addressed switch
Mmd
MDIO Manageable Device
Parameters (in)
RegIdx
Index of the transceiver register on the SMI.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
RegValPtr
Filled with the register content of the indexed register
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Service accepted
E_NOT_OK: Service denied
Description
Reads a transceiver register using Clause 45 access if supported by hardware or implements a
Clause 45 access using Clause 22 operations.
Available via
EthSwt.h
⌋
